message.content:
Here’s a quick‑and‑easy outline you can tweak to fit your exact dates and interests:

| Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening |
|-----|---------|-----------|---------|
| **1 – Arrival** | Fly into Charles de Gaulle (or Orly). Take the RER B or a taxi to your hotel in the 7th/8th arrondissement. | Check‑in, freshen up, stroll along the Seine to Notre‑Dame & Île Saint‑Louis. | Dinner at a classic bistro (e.g., Le Coupe Chou) and a night walk over Pont Neuf. |
| **2 – Classic Landmarks** | Louvre Museum (arrive early to beat crowds). | Walk through Palais Royal gardens → Place Vendôme → Champs‑Élysées. | Sunset cruise on the Seine (Bateaux Mouches) or a show at Moulin Rouge. |
| **3 – Montmartre & Sacré‑Coeur** | Climb to Sacré‑Coeur, explore artists’ square. | Visit Musée de Montmartre & Espace Dalí. | Dinner in Pigalle, then jazz club (Le Caveau de la Huchette). |
| **4 – Day Trip** | Train to Versailles (RER C). Explore the palace & gardens. | Picnic lunch in the gardens. | Return to Paris, light dinner near your hotel. |
| **5 – Modern Art & Shopping** | Centre Pompidou or Fondation Louis Vuitton. | Lunch at Les Halles, then shopping on Rue Saint‑Honoré. | Rooftop bar (Le Perchoir) for sunset views. |
| **6 – Leisure & Culture** | Free morning – optional visit to Musée d’Orsay or a cooking class. | Explore Latin Quarter cafés & bookshops. | Dinner at a Michelin‑starred restaurant (book well in advance). |
| **7 – Departure** | Pack, last stroll along the Seine, grab croissants from a local bakery. | Head to the airport via RER or taxi. | Flight home. |

### Practical Tips

| Topic | Recommendation |
|-------|----------------|
| **Flights** | Book round‑trip tickets to CDG or ORY. Use airlines like Air France, KLM, or budget carriers (Norwegian, Ryanair) depending on price vs comfort. |
| **Accommodation** | Stay central (7th, 8th, or 16th arr.) for easy access. Options: Hôtel Le Meurice (luxury), Hotel Ekta (boutique), or Airbnb in Le Marais for a local vibe. |
| **Transport** | Purchase a Navigo Week Pass (€22.80) for unlimited metro/RER rides. For day trips, buy a single ticket or a multi‑day pass. |
| **Dining** | Reserve restaurants 2–3 weeks ahead. Try local specialties: escargot, coq au vin, macarons. |
| **Tickets** | Pre‑buy Louvre, Eiffel Tower, and Versailles tickets online to skip queues. |
| **Packing** | Light layers, comfortable walking shoes, umbrella, universal adapter. |
| **Safety** | Keep valuables secure, stay aware of pickpockets in tourist areas. |

Feel free to let me know your travel dates, budget, or specific interests (food, art, history, nightlife) so I can fine‑tune this plan further!
